name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Top U.S. DOJ official orders California to review list of possible noncitizens who received mail ballots
changes.summary: The Justice Department has ordered California to review a list of people whom the federal government believes may have received mail-in ballots for the upcoming election despite not being U.S. citizens.

changes.title: U.S. blasts "embarrassing" complaint against Lebanon's ambassador
changes.summary: The Trump administration sharply criticized a legal complaint filed in Lebanon against the country's ambassador to Washington over her reported outreach to her Israeli counterpart.

changes.title: Inflation climbs in September as energy prices soar, CPI report shows
changes.summary: U.S. inflation rose higher than economists predicted amid high energy prices, the most recent Consumer Price Index report shows. Axios markets reporter Matt Phillips shares his thoughts.

changes.title: Will my lack of country-specific grants limit my chances of employment abroad?
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 14 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02442-3 A researcher in Latin America seeks advice on the best way to present themselves when applying for faculty positions in Europe and North America.

changes.title: Growing plane and ship traffic degrade the air of western North America
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 14 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03239-0 Pollution from transport across the Pacific Ocean is raising ozone levels above a region whose own emissions have dropped.

changes.title: Joni Mitchell becomes an American citizen after more than 60 years
changes.summary: Joni Mitchell can see both sides of the U.S.-Canada border freely now.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy sits down with NPR to talks about the ongoing war in his country, Pope Leo has lung cancer, the Vatican announced, U.S. ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns.

changes.title: South Americans pray for Pope Leo's recovery as uncertainty hangs over his visit
changes.summary: Roman Catholics across South America responded to news of Pope Leo XIV's lung cancer diagnosis with an outpouring of prayers and support, along with concerns about whether the first American pope would go ahead with his highly anticipated and physically demanding visit to the region next month.

changes.title: Sudden Starlink limits sap Ukraine drone power as Kyiv fears U.S. intelligence squeeze
changes.summary: Ukrainian drones lost some of their fighting capacity after restrictions were suddenly imposed on the battlefield use of the country's U.S.-made Starlink communication terminals, officials said Wednesday as the capital endured another night of missile attacks.

changes.title: Higher Energy Prices Pushed U.S. Inflation Up to 3.7% Ahead of Midterm Elections
changes.summary: September’s Consumer Price Index report will keep pressure on President Trump and the Federal Reserve to tame intensifying price pressures.
